## Problem and resulting behaviour

What changes, and which acceptance criteria does it satisfy?

## Context

Course requirement/source IDs or team decision; label assumptions and examples.

## Validation

Exact commands and results; mention checks not run and why. Setup checks alone do
not establish API, database or deployment correctness.

## AI assistance

Tool/model if known, short prompt purpose, affected work, and a link to the relevant
entry in docs/ai-use.md (or explain the course policy exemption).

## Review and follow-up

- [ ] Another group member reviewed this change before merge.
- [ ] Behaviour/contract/project-context docs match the change.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and follow-ups are stated.

Leave human-review boxes unchecked until that review actually happens.
